probes.text: Jon and Daenerys take the dragons up together, flying over the North and landing alone in the snow.
The combined armies march into Winterfell while wary Northerners line the road watching the Dothraki and Unsullied pass.
Jon and Arya see each other again for the first time in years, comparing their swords.

probes.text: Sam presents Jorah with House Tarly's ancestral Valyrian sword before the battle, insisting he take it.
Daenerys sits with Sansa and tries to win her trust by invoking their mutual love for Jon.
Jorah tries to talk young Lyanna Mormont out of taking part in the fighting.

fine_only.text: Jon and Daenerys fight from dragonback high above the snow, hunting a rider through the night sky.
During the feast Daenerys rises and grants Gendry a lordship and the seat of Storm's End.
